name: DEI
summary: Post-apocalyptic area-control game where factions fight to survive in frozen London by gathering and trading resources.
rules_text: 2-4 players each lead a faction on a modular board of icy London. On your turn you move your figures across regions to claim majority and control outposts. You play and acquire action cards from a market to improve actions and to activate drones. You send looters to collect resources from the board. At the Citadel you trade collected resources for vital supply tokens. Drones can be steered to gain advantages in combat or collection. After a set number of rounds or when supply piles run out, the game ends and the faction that has accumulated the most supplies wins.
rating_reason: Specific game DEI but no mechanics described
